## Implementation Complete

**Change:** `apply-coupon-to-order` (schema: spec-driven) — 9/9 tasks complete, `openspec validate` passes.

Planning artifacts in `openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/`: `proposal.md`, `specs/order-coupons/spec.md`, `design.md`, `tasks.md`.

Implementation:
- `src/routes/orders.ts:11` — `POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon`.
- `src/services/orderService.ts:52` — validation ordering + discount calc, persisted atomically.
- `src/repositories/orderRepository.ts` / `couponRepository.ts` — `applyCoupon`, `recordRedemption`.
- `src/db.ts:47` — `withTransaction`; `src/app.ts` wiring.
- `tests/apply-coupon.test.ts` — 15 integration tests (benchmark `tests/orders.test.ts` and `TASK.md` untouched).

Behavior: FIXED/PERCENT discounts (floored, capped by `maxDiscountCents`, clamped to order amount); 404 `ORDER_NOT_FOUND`/`COUPON_NOT_FOUND`; 409 `ORDER_NOT_PENDING`, `ORDER_ALREADY_HAS_COUPON`, `COUPON_NOT_ACTIVE`, `COUPON_NOT_YET_VALID`, `COUPON_EXPIRED`, `COUPON_MIN_AMOUNT_NOT_MET`, `COUPON_USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED`; 400 `INVALID_REQUEST`.

Verified: `npm run build` passes, `npm test` 20/20 pass. Not archived (left as workflow follow-up per tasks.md).
